q1.sampleAnswer:
Hello Alex,
I’m very pleased to get your email. You asked me about the next weekend’s party. I’m so happy that my parents let me go to the party. You can’t even imagine how I’m excited. I think it will be the best party ever!
Unfortunately, I can’t bring a chocolate cake but I’m able to bring sandwiches with salmon or cheese.
I guess, it would be nice but it will be too hot and hard to dance in dress. Maybe people should dress in light clothes?
What about the table game called, Monopoly? It’s a calm game and interesting at the same time.
Bye,
Michael

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：回应邮件中的四条笔记：①也很期待派对（Me too!）；②不能带巧克力蛋糕，但可以带别的（No, but …）；③告诉 Alex 你对大家穿特别服装（扮成动物或名人）的看法（Tell Alex）；④建议一个大家可以一起玩的游戏（Suggest …）
交际效果：文体和语气符合任务要求，能清楚表达观点并吸引读者
条理性：结构清晰、衔接连贯，使用多种连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的丰富性与准确性

anchors.noteZh: 内容5/交际效果5/条理性4/语言4。四个要点都充分回应；语气统一（Hello Alex, I guess, What about, Bye），不同意原邮件时给出了替代建议和理由（I can’t bring … but I’m able to; it would be nice but it will be too hot）；分段回应每个要点，用 Unfortunately, I guess, What about 引出新观点，但第二段短句较多，可多用连接词；日常词汇恰当（sandwiches, salmon, light clothes），情态动词和多种时态运用熟练，错误极少（the next weekend’s party, how I’m excited）。

q1.explanationZh: 满分邮件要逐一回应四条笔记：表示也很期待派对，说明不能带巧克力蛋糕但可以带别的，表明是否赞成穿特别服装并说明理由，再推荐一个游戏；语气友好自然，约 100 词。

q2.sampleAnswer:
In the area I’m living in, there is a big park just opposite my house. I used to go there everyday with the kids from neighbour when I was small.
There are many facilities in the park – see-saw, monkey bars, slides, swings and even jogging paths. The park is big enough for us to play hide and seek. There are flora and fauna surrounding the park, You can definetely enjoy the beauty of nature while in the park.
For now, I will still go and jog at the park every weekends. Afterwards, I will sit at the bench for a rest and watch the old men and women playing Taichi. Hard to believe but the garden is getting popular and crowded in my area compare to the days when I was small!

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：文章回答公告中的问题：①介绍你所在地区一个你非常喜欢的地方，以及为什么喜欢；②你什么时候去那里；③这个地方是否也受其他人欢迎
交际效果：文体和语气符合任务要求，能清楚表达观点并吸引读者
条理性：结构清晰、衔接连贯，使用多种连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的丰富性与准确性

anchors.response:
A special place
A special place for me is a garden named “Rose Garden” that near my house. This garden was built by a rich man. The rich man built this garden because he is no time to come back to hometown to visit his father. So, he hopes this garden can make his father not lonely.
Rose Garden is fulled of variety kinds of rose flower. There are red, white, yellow, purple and blue colour for roses. I will go there every weekend to revise my homework and see roses. It’s also a leisure moment at there when I read novel and get a cup of coffee.
Rose Garden is popular with other people too because you do not pay entrance fee and there are really stunning flewless. Some of film companies will go there to take scene for drama. Meanwhile, some of couples will go there to take photo when they got married.
I love Rose Garden too much. I hope more people can know this place and visit it. You can search “Rose Garden, Malaysia” for more details.
anchors.noteZh: 内容5/交际效果3/条理性3/语言3。回答了所有问题；文体基本适宜，有一些描写（stunning flewless），并举例说明别人如何使用这个地方（film companies, couples），但错误较多，影响整体表达效果；四段结构清楚，每段大致谈一个问题，但段内信息有重复（The rich man built this garden），只用 This, because, So, also 等简单衔接；词汇基本恰当（leisure, entrance fee, stunning），但简单结构出错较多（he is no time, is fulled of），flewless 影响理解。

q2.explanationZh: 满分文章要介绍一个你喜欢的本地地方，说明喜欢的原因、什么时候去以及它是否受其他人欢迎；文体像杂志文章，有描写、能吸引读者，约 100 词。

q3.sampleAnswer:
My first singing competition
Everybody clapped when I walked onto the stage. It was my first singing competition and I had butterflies in my stomach! I thought I was going to throw up! But I took some deep breaths and I started singing. My voice was beautiful and when I finished, everybody started cheering and clapping. I was crying tears of joy. It was the best moment in all my life! I said thanks to all of the audience and I ran out to the stage. As soon as I got home, I kissed and hugged my mum and my dad. I was over the moon!

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：故事以给定的句子开头（我走上舞台时大家都鼓掌），情节与开头句相关、合乎逻辑，有清楚的开头、发展和结尾

语言：词汇和语法结构的丰富性与准确性
